description.text:
The third Radiant Energy (辉耀能量) theme pack holds two cards. One is one of four made in equal numbers: Horsea, Rockruff and Eevee with new artwork, or Celebratory Fanfare, whose art shows many Pokémon celebrating together. The other is a holo basic Energy with a radiant border, here Grass, Lightning or Metal, or a holo Trainer or Pokémon; with luck it is a special-art Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR, Origin Forme Dialga VSTAR, Giratina VSTAR or Arceus VSTAR.

The packs came only in gift boxes. Three art sleeve gift boxes, Dialga, Palkia and Giratina, came out on 20 September 2024 with Shadow of the Blue Sea, each with one pack, black and gold sleeves, a coin die, four damage-counter dice, a storage box and 30 five-card Shadow of the Blue Sea packs; the Arceus New Star gift box (阿尔宙斯新星礼盒) of the same day held two packs. On 15 November 2024 three Radiant Energy binder gift boxes, for the Grass, Lightning and Metal types, held one each and the Partners' Gathering exclusive gift box (伙伴们的欢聚 专属礼盒) held three; the Giratina VSTAR Advanced Deck Building Gift Box of 21 December 2024 held one too. Its four main cards are numbered out of 4; the Energy, the full-art Trainers and Pokémon V, the rainbow Trainers and the four gold VSTAR cards are numbered past it, up to 024.
